summary: Audit of libssh 0.11.4 Conan recipe (10 changed files). VERDICT: PASS (no P0 or P1 blocking issues). Deception checks all pass: (1) test.c calls real libssh API (ssh_init, ssh_version, ssh_finalize) — not an empty shell test (R34 satisfied); (2) sha256 verified against actual download from www.libssh.org — not faked; (3) manifest status 'built' is legitimate; (4) no skipped tests (cmake.test() is called); (5) no pre-compiled binaries; (6) no empty #ifdef __OHOS__ stubs; (7) libssh does not fall into R40 deep-adaptation categories. Recipe correctness checks all pass: Conan 2.x API used, official source URL, static build by default, proper method ordering, cpp_info.libs set. 12 P2 warnings (non-blocking): template placeholder 'url=""' in conanfile.py, incorrect patch_type/patch_description in conandata.yml, manifest patches field name mismatch, and multiple unfilled template sections in notes.md. 8 P3 suggestions: notes.md has wrong build command (./configure vs cmake), stale dates, zlib version typo in manifest notes, unused import in test_package, double blank line, missing WITH_EXAMPLES in manifest, local paths in patch_generation, and incomplete patch classification.
